claims: Kieran Culkin won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar at the 97th Academy Awards in March 2025 for his role in A Real Pain.
During his 2025 acceptance speech, Kieran Culkin referenced a pact with his wife, Jazz Charton, regarding having more children.
Kieran Culkin appeared at the 2026 Oscars to present.
This video shows Kieran Culkin accepting an award on behalf of Sean Penn at the Oscars
